headline: Find Chirpi
title: Where to Find Chirpi | Basic and Beach Forms | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Chirpi is a small Wind support Aniimo that can fly, and you can find it in many regions. The basic form lives in Nimbus Fields, The Argent Strait, Beast Fang Ridge and Blitzwood. The Beach form appears at Echoback Landing. Beginners should start in Nimbus Fields, where wild levels stay low. Later it can evolve at level eighteen. Which Chirpi form do you want? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Chirpi is a flying Wind support found in Nimbus Fields, The Argent Strait, Beast Fang Ridge and Blitzwood. The Beach form lives at Echoback Landing.
